subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: What should the supported Telegram album message-tool API be: auto-group eligible mediaUrls, add an explicit mediaGroup/album parameter, or add a separate send-media-group action?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-backed, but the permanent API shape affects the message tool contract, Telegram plugin boundaries, docs, tests, and compatibility with existing sequential mediaUrls behavior.

options.title: Explicit album parameter
options.body: Add a clearly documented mediaGroup or album array on the existing send action, grouping only eligible 2-10 Telegram photo/video items and falling back otherwise.

options.title: Auto-group mediaUrls
options.body: Treat existing mediaUrls as album candidates on Telegram when they meet API constraints, accepting more implicit behavior change for current callers.

options.title: Separate send-media-group action
options.body: Keep current send behavior unchanged and expose album sending as a new Telegram-specific action, at the cost of another user-facing action surface.

recommendation.title: Explicit album parameter
recommendation.body: Add a clearly documented mediaGroup or album array on the existing send action, grouping only eligible 2-10 Telegram photo/video items and falling back otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: This person already reviewed the issue and has the strongest combined signal across Telegram send/action history and product-boundary cleanup.
